messages:
incidentbot: SEV1 alert: GPU pool gpu-eu-2 queue length > 950 (threshold 200), observed sustained growth for 7m, 35% request throttles. Auto-scaler attempted 3 scale actions and failed (quota/attach-error). Paging: @emma (oncall)

emma (oncall): seeing the alerts, joining. can someone grab a quick impact count?

liang (sre): hi, I'm looking. initial: traffic spike after rollout of model-v3.1 in eu region. KV-index size jumped ~3x, prefix warmup is flooding the pool.

maya (infra): autoscaler logs show attach failures: vendor error 403 quota_exceeded on 2 attempts, then rate-limit. also see batches backing up in the ingress queue.

emma (oncall): ok immediate plan: 1) throttle new model traffic 2) failover to model-v3.0 3) try manual scale up once quota confirmed. who can do 1&2 now?

liang (sre): i'll update routing policy to move 60% of v3.1 -> v3.0 and keep 40% to observe. command: `redwoodctl routing update --pool gpu-eu-2 --route model-v3.1=0.4,model-v3.0=0.6`

deploy-bot: rollback job started for rollout model-v3.1 -> pinned model-v3.0 in eu clusters. job id: deploy-8821.

ops: started emergency ticket with vendor for quota bump (case 11988). tentative ETA 45m.

emma (oncall): support-bot can you surface list of customers seeing 429s / >1s p50 latency in eu?

support-bot: affected_customers: ["acme-inc","fastchat","notespro","internalsandbox"]. ~12 total tenants showing elevated errors; highest traffic tenants are acme-inc and fastchat.

liang (sre): observed kv-index spillover and hotprefix growth when warmup hits long-context requests. temporarily disabling prefix caching for v3.1 on gpu-eu-2 to reduce write IO: `redwoodctl model config set model-v3.1 --pool gpu-eu-2 --prefix_cache=false`

maya (infra): applied the config. queue length dropped from 980 -> 420 in 3 minutes. throttles still present but trending down.

emma (oncall): nice. continuing actions: set autoscaler max_replicas +30 but only if vendor confirms more GPUs. DO NOT autoscale beyond quota. liang, patch autoscaler to return errors faster to avoid repeated attach churn.

liang (sre): updated autoscaler backoff window to 5m and increased attach retry delay. patch command: ```
kubectl patch cm autoscaler-config -n infra --type merge -p '{"data":{"attach_backoff":"5m","attach_retry_delay":"30s"}}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy revert completed for eu pools, model traffic now primarily on model-v3.0.

ops: vendor says quota request acknowledged, provisional increase in 30-60m, but they recommend gradual attach to avoid more rate-limits.

emma (oncall): customer comms: @support-bot draft outbound: "We experienced degraded performance and throttles in EU for some requests after a model rollout. We’ve rolled back the rollout, applied mitigations, and are monitoring. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline to fix permanently."

support-bot: draft queued for review.

javier (oncall-2nd): I'll take next 1hr watch. summary for handoff: rollback to v3.0, prefix caching disabled for v3.1 in eu, autoscaler backoff increased, vendor quota request open. severity downgraded to SEV2, impact reduced but still elevated for top tenants.

emma (oncall): thanks team. open action items: (1) postmortem to cover why prefix warmup spikes weren't caught in canary (owner: eng-runtime) (2) autoscaler hard-limit behavior doc/update (owner: eng-sre) (3) vendor quota escalation follow-up (owner: ops). I'll create the incident ticket and assign.

liang (sre): adding note: long-context traffic pattern changed in v3.1 — need better model-quality/throughput evals in pre-rollout.

emma (oncall): closing this thread for active paging, keep updates in #incidents-updates. thanks all. :thumbsup:
